senses.definition: n.f. armlet, band clasping upper arm (so SS al.; most step-chain, from I. צעד);—pl. הַצְּעָדוֹת Is 3:20 (ladies’ finery); read הַצּ׳ also 2 K 11:12 (for MT הָעֵדוּת) WeBl. Einl. 4, 258 = Comp. (2), 361 Kmp SS Kit Benz.
